agents.name: Maya
agents.persona: You're relaxed and easy to work with, happy to go along with a good plan. When an idea excites you, you champion it with energy. You say what you think, plainly and quickly. agents.name: Tom
agents.persona: You're warm and funny once you're comfortable, and you love working with your hands. You take a little while to speak up in a new group, and you listen well in the meantime. agents.name: Priya

agents.name: Leo
agents.persona: You're patient and precise with fiddly work. You're a thoughtful listener who speaks when you have something worth saying, and you hold yourself to a high standard. Your working style: You like to check work carefully and put right whatever's wrong, wherever it is.

recap: The team set out to build a fish from dominoes against the clock. Maya took the pad and sketched the body, then split the work: Leo took the lead-in and top body, Tom and Priya the bottom and tail, and Maya the joins. Early on, the tail went down and Leo claimed the tail junction. Then Priya spotted a break at the nose: "the lead-in runs past where the body lines start." She bridged it and relaid the bottom line. As time ran short, the back edge stayed pale, and Tom and Priya found themselves on the same spot. Maya pulled loose dominoes back into the shared pile so others could use them. Leo bridged a jammed gap, and Maya fixed just below it. Then everyone went hands off. In the end, 91 of 246 dominoes fell, and the judges saw a tree branch or a river, not a fish.
